mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_meeting_reviewed_search_plan (meeting_id, round_number, member_id, target_question_id, as_of, context_opinion_id, supersedes_plan_id, normalized_plan_json) VALUES (#{meetingId}, #{roundNumber}, #{memberId}, #{targetQuestionId}, #{asOf}, #{contextOpinionId}, #{supersedesPlanId}, #{normalizedPlanJson})

INSERT INTO ai_meeting_reviewed_search_gap (meeting_id, round_number, as_of, question_hash, exact_question, request_id, status) VALUES (#{meetingId}, #{roundNumber}, #{asOf}, #{questionHash}, #{exactQuestion}, #{requestId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_meeting_reviewed_search_gap SET status = 'IN_FLIGHT', gmt_modify = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{gapId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE ai_meeting_reviewed_search_gap SET status = 'PENDING', gmt_modify = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{gapId} AND status = 'IN_FLIGHT'
UPDATE ai_meeting_reviewed_search_gap SET status = 'CROSS_CHECKED', packet_json = #{packetJson}, status_reason = NULL, gmt_modify = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{gapId} AND status = 'IN_FLIGHT'
UPDATE ai_meeting_reviewed_search_gap SET status = 'LOW_CONFIDENCE', packet_json = #{packetJson}, status_reason = NULL, gmt_modify = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{gapId} AND status = 'IN_FLIGHT'
UPDATE ai_meeting_reviewed_search_gap SET status = 'UNKNOWN', status_reason = #{reason}, gmt_modify = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{gapId} AND status = 'IN_FLIGHT'

UPDATE ai_meeting_reviewed_search_gap SET status = 'PENDING', status_reason = #{reason}, gmt_modify = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{gapId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_FLIGHT', 'REJECTED', 'UNKNOWN')
UPDATE ai_meeting_reviewed_search_gap SET status = 'REJECTED', status_reason = #{reason}, gmt_modify = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{gapId} AND status = 'IN_FLIGHT'
